notes:
Summary: Argentum is a fintech analytics platform consolidating regulatory, legal, and historical trade documents. Primary ask is a massive-scale semantic search stack: 100M initially with roadmap to 1B+ dense vectors, vector lifecycle (ingest/ttl/upsert), and a tight reranking pipeline for regulatory review workflows. Key constraints: p50 latency 100-150ms for reranking path (embedding->candidate retrieval->on-device neural reranker), throughput spikes during end-of-quarter audits, and strict data residency + KMS-backed encryption.

Technical details & requirements (from SE calls):
- Index size targets: 100M vectors in POC, scale to 1B in production within 12-18 months. Average vector dim 512-1536 depending on model.
- Query pattern: bursty peak concurrency (2k-5k qps) during batch audits; baseline steady-state 200-800 qps.
- Latency SLOs: 100-150ms p50 for reranked top-10; p95 budget 400ms.
- Cost sensitivity: goal <$0.002 per query at scale (Including retrieval + rerank). Interested in batching, KV/prefix caching, persistent cache between similar queries.
- Model preferences: open-embedding models preferred (quantizable) plus an option to run a proprietary reranker. Looking at mixed-precision inference and quantized 4/8-bit kernels.
- Routing/fallback: primary dedicated GPU pool + fallback to hosted smaller models for degraded latency or surge. Need automated fallback & deterministic degrade (no hallucination during legal review).
- Ingest & lifecycle: transactional upserts from internal DBs, daily bulk re-index, soft-TTL for ephemeral data. Must support efficient partial re-embeds.

POC ask: Redwood Dedicated or Private install to prove unit economics at 100M vectors. POC success metrics: ingest throughput >= 200k vectors/hour for initial bulk load, sustained query throughput 1k qps with <200ms p50, and cost estimate that meets finance target. SE deliverables: sizing doc, reference throughput benchmarks, on-prem deployment checklist, security questionnaire answers.

Quotes / call snippets:
- "We can't accept >400ms tail for legal reranking — regulators will flag latency that blocks triage." — Head of Search, Argentum.
- "If you can shave cost/per-query by 3x compared to our current hosted provider we'll move to Dedicated." — VP Finance.

Risks & open items:
- Legal wants explicit data residency clause and log retention >7 years; may require on-prem isolated region.
- Need deeper proof of batching/caching gains on their workload (long, repetitive query prefixes). SE to run synthetic workload with their telemetry.
- GPU fleet pricing negotiation; enterprise procurement process will require SOW + commitment.
